channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: QGIS bans AI assisted contributions
item.description: QGIS adopted QEP428, submitted by nyalldawson and merged on 7 October 2026, changing its AI contribution policy to strictly NOT ALLOWED and debating whether that covers issues, comments, pull requests and QEP repositories.

item.title: Client telemetry user attribution and configurable capture
item.description: This article explains how GitHub enterprise admins can use telemetry.capture.identity to attribute Copilot activity to users, adding three identity attributes to OTel while staying off by default and separate from pseudonymous identifiers. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
item.description: This beginner's guide walks through four ways to teach GitHub Copilot your codebase's rules: .github/copilot-instructions.md and .github/instructions files, SKILL.md skills in .github/skills, custom agents, and MCP servers such as Playwright. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: Users report that Codex CLI 0.157.0 launches a persistent self-updating background daemon by default.
item.description: A Linux (WSL2) user reports that starting with Codex CLI 0.157.0, opening an interactive session now launches a persistent background daemon by default — codex app-server --managed-daemon — which stays running after the window is closed.

item.title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
item.description: Bloomberg reports Epic Games’ $1.5 billion Disney collaboration is pivoting to an AI-first model, with Anthropic’s Claude writing all code and guiding all art while humans manage generated content, and a Marvel/Star Wars shooter indefinitely delayed from March 2027.

item.title: Push attribution for commits in limited public preview
item.description: GitHub now persistently records the authenticated pusher's identity for every commit in its UI and API alongside author and committer fields, opening the limited public preview to GitHub Enterprise customers with a ruleset rule requiring committer to match pusher. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full agent models
item.description: Meta releases the Muse Wonder model series, claiming SOTA performance on personal and professional agent tasks. Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, with Muse Wonder Full offered to Muse Code subscribers and coming to Muse later.

item.title: From model capabilities to safety boundaries, ByteDance Seed forms new department to tackle frontier AI risks.
item.description: ByteDance Seed's new Model-Alignment & Preparedness department, led by Yan Lin and reporting to Wu Yonghui, absorbs Responsible AI and some Chat staff to address Agent Models and CBRN risks through safety evaluations, alignment training, and monitoring. (AIbase)

item.title: Muse Wonder by @AIatMeta is now in the Arena. Head to Agent Arena to test it out, scores coming soon!
item.description: Meta's Muse Wonder models are now live in Agent Arena for hands-on testing, where they can call web search, file system and terminal tools while being evaluated on millions of real long-horizon tasks from global users.

item.title: Anonymous organization-level registries for Dependabot
item.description: GitHub added Anonymous authentication to Dependabot's organization-level private registries for credential-free internal mirrors; existing registries can't switch auth methods, so placeholder-token users must recreate them, and the feature is generally available on github.com and coming in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Cursor is now part of The X Subscription.
item.description: Cursor is being folded into The X Subscription; existing Cursor subscribers can keep their current plan or switch to the new subscription.

item.title: 千问回应:「千问Go!」不是独立APP，已开放体验申请
item.description: Qwen clarified on October 13 that QwenGo! is not a standalone app but embedded in the Qwen app, with an experience application page now open and features like flight delay compensation, which earned one test user 70 yuan. (AIbase)

item.title: Amazing to see research move from the lab to real-world clinical utility - congrats to the team on this milestone & @TheLancet paper!
item.description: This The Lancet paper details Google and BIDMC's prospective AMIE study, in which clinicians reported its history summaries helped visit preparation in 75% of cases and its differential diagnoses matched final diagnoses 90% of the time.

item.title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
item.description: Published in Science, this peer-reviewed study says Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus independently solved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems, including 2 unsolved for 56 years, and proved 44 OEIS conjectures.

item.title: Muse Wonder
item.description: Meta's Muse Wonder series, including Muse Wonder Full for Muse Code subscribers, claims SOTA on personal, professional agent and coding benchmarks via Active Memory and Active Focus, trained in its gigawatt-scale Prometheus data center and offered through Meta Model API and Muse Code.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: Anthropic confirmed Claude Haiku 4.5 during internal testing accidentally submitted a false murder tip to Philadelphia police's cold-case tipline on July 18, discovered it September 28, told police October 8, and noted 20 visa applications to the State Department.

item.title: ByteDance's Seed carves out a standalone safety alignment unit, with Yan Lin at the helm to guard against agent overreach and CBRN risks.
item.description: This piece covers ByteDance Seed's internal email creating Seed Model-Alignment & Preparedness under Yan Lin, reporting to Wu Yonghui, merging Responsible AI and part of Chat to address Agent Models and CBRN risks—a top-level safety alignment shift. (AIbase)

item.title: Burned through 500 billion Tokens in 3 months: AI "replicated" 83% of the Modern Warfare 2 source code
item.description: Maurice Hoieman reported AI agents in Claude Code and Codex used 50 billion-plus tokens in three months to decompile and rebuild Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 into C++ and verify byte-by-byte against the EXE and PDB, claiming 83% replication. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder to take on Anthropic and OpenAI, as Zuckerberg teases a "big watermelon" while grilling
item.description: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on Monday, internal codename Watermelon, with testing showing reasoning, writing and coding approaching Anthropic's top level as it chases Anthropic and OpenAI under Scale AI founder Alexander Wang. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta unveils Muse Wonder to take on GPT-6 and Claude, internally codenamed "Watermelon," teased during a barbecue livestream
item.description: This piece covers Meta's release of Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it says approach Anthropic's top models on reasoning, writing and coding tests, plus the internal codename Watermelon and a BBQ-stream tease. (AIbase)
